units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevuot 5:9">Tosef. Shebu. V, 9</cite> <he>דינר זהב ז׳</he> a gold denar in coin, contrad. to <he>דינר זהב</he> the value of a gold denar; <cite ref="Shevuot 40a:7">Shebu. 40ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 10:4:5">Y. Shebi. X, end, 39ᵈ</cite> <he>מה בין ז׳ וכ׳</he> what is the difference between a gold coin (as a pledge) and a gold ring?—<he>ז׳ דרכו להשתנות</he> a gold coin may be exchanged (the pledgee being permitted to use it).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35:1">Ex. R. s. 35</cite>; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>זְהוּבִים</he>.
